title: mut.channel_cndsd_ivan_abreu
mutation_directive: Lumen Prize winner — CNDSD & Ivan Abreu (2023 · Gold) — 'AUTO{}Construccion'. VISUAL SIGNATURE: Live-coded speculative architecture — informal housing assembling and disassembling itself in real time, strict geometric scaffolds breaking into rhythmic glitches synchronized to sound. TECHNICAL HOOKS: Voxel/box swarms snapping to a stochastic L-system grammar that grows rooms, then dissolves walls into falling cubes on each downbeat — geometry: instanced cubes; motion: discrete grid steps + gravity collapse; palette: rebar gray, cinder block, neon code-flash. REF: https://lumenprize.org/2023-winners
